title: BodyPartState
description: A state of a part (since 1.5): what a node sets on the model to put the part in it.

id.description: The state's id (shown or hidden for a single toggle).

name.description: What she calls the state: a group's name of it, for a single toggle the words the user gave the state (worn, taken off), else shown or hidden. Show it; match on the id.

default.description: Whether it is the part's default state.

toggles.description: The part's toggles as this state sets them.
